name: prometheus-exporter
title: Prometheus Exporter
author: bespoked
description: Runs scross01/prometheus-klipper-exporter as a managed service so you can scrape Klipper/Moonraker metrics into Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc. It is a multi-target exporter: the printer's series come from :9101/probe?target=127.0.0.1:7125 (the U1's Moonraker), while bare :9101/metrics carries only the exporter's own runtime. The exporter is a small Go binary cross-compiled for the printer in CI and baked into the package; nothing is built on the printer. Observability for people who run a metrics stack; most users will not need it. Verified on a Snapmaker U1.
tagline: Klipper/Moonraker metrics in Prometheus format for Grafana & co.
